## PR Quality Checklist

- [ ] **One Reviewer**: Assigned at least one team member or designated code owner for review.
- [ ] **Build Verification**: Verified that local build passes (`npm run build` exits 0).
- [ ] **Secret Safety**: Confirmed that NO `.env*` files, API keys, credentials, or real secrets are committed.
- [ ] **Lint / Type Check**: Confirmed TypeScript compilation (`npx tsc --noEmit`) and lint pass without errors.
